products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai is an enterprise software company that describes itself as providing an AI-programmable platform for building, scaling, and optimizing AI agents focused on customer service and employee productivity. The company's core offering, the Kore.ai Agent Platform 2.0, is designed to support multi-agent orchestration, agentic retrieval-augmented generation search, and integration with existing business systems and workflows. The platform is positioned to handle both scripted and reasoning AI on shared infrastructure, with runtime-layer compliance controls, pre-deployment workflow validation, and complete logging of interactions for audit purposes.

The company's held facts describe its platform as an enterprise agentic AI product serving more than 400 Fortune 2000 customers, with capabilities including multi-agent orchestration and a governance dashboard featuring audit logs, role-based access controls, and guardrails. Kore.ai notes strategic partnerships with Microsoft and AWS as part of its enterprise delivery infrastructure. The company has received recognition from Forrester in multiple Wave reports, including for Conversational AI Platforms for Employee Services, Conversational AI for Customer Service, and Cognitive Search Platforms 2025, where Forrester recognized Kore.ai as a leader and noted it received the highest score possible across 11 criteria and ranked highest in the strategy category. The Everest Group also included the company in its Agentic AI Products PEAK Matrix Assessment.
